title.zh: Hyperliquid将上线11只代币化美股与ETF现货，明日正式开放交易
title.en: Hyperliquid将上线11只代币化美股与ETF现货，明日正式开放交易

current_state.zh: Hyperliquid will list 11 USDC-denominated HIP-1 spot markets for EQX Labs-issued tokenized US stocks and ETFs, including S&P 500 and Nasdaq-100 trackers and single-name exposure to Nvidia, Tesla, Apple, Microsoft, Amazon, Alphabet, Meta, Micron and SpaceX, with trading opening October 26 at 21:30 Beijing time.
current_state.en: Hyperliquid will list 11 USDC-denominated HIP-1 spot markets for EQX Labs-issued tokenized US stocks and ETFs, including S&P 500 and Nasdaq-100 trackers and single-name exposure to Nvidia, Tesla, Apple, Microsoft, Amazon, Alphabet, Meta, Micron and SpaceX, with trading opening October 26 at 21:30 Beijing time.

updates.title_zh: Hyperliquid将上线11只代币化美股与ETF现货，明日正式开放交易
updates.title_en: Hyperliquid将上线11只代币化美股与ETF现货，明日正式开放交易
updates.what_changed_zh:
Hyperliquid 将上线由 EQX Labs 发行的代币化美股与 ETF，首批共 11 个以 USDC 计价的 HIP-1 现货市场，标的包括追踪标普 500 与纳斯达克 100 的 EQSPY、EQQQQ，以及对应英伟达、特斯拉、苹果、微软、亚马逊、Alphabet、Meta、美光与 SpaceX 的单一标的。相关代币已在 Hyperliquid 主网注册上线，但撮合交易要到北京时间 10 月 26 日 21:30（美东时间同日 9:30）才正式开启。

此次上线使这一大型链上衍生品交易平台新增代币化股票资产类别，让主要美股与指数追踪标的在传统交易时段之外也能在链上交易。不过交易尚未开始，流动性和监管反应均未经过检验。

EQX 称每个代币由真实股份 1:1 支持，但法律结构为英属维尔京群岛隔离组合公司发行的有限追索权债务凭证，而非直接持有股票，且不对美国人士开放。

updates.background_zh: 据 Hyperliquid 平台自述，其运营 300 多个永续与现货市场，全部在链上运行且为非托管模式。过去一年代币化股票持续扩张，例如 Backed Finance 的 xStocks 由托管持有的标的股票 1:1 支持，并通过 Kraken、Bybit 等平台分发。
updates.background_en: Hyperliquid operates 300+ perpetual and spot markets fully onchain and non-custodial, according to its own platform description. Tokenized equities have expanded over the past year through products such as Backed Finance's xStocks, which are backed 1:1 by underlying equities held in custody and distributed via venues including Kraken and Bybit.
updates.market_impact_zh: 这一举措把对美股与指数敞口的现货需求引入 Hyperliquid 以 USDC 结算的订单簿，使该平台的现货流动性与以 HYPE 计价的活动同可全天候运行的代币化股票资金流挂钩。BVI 债务凭证结构与排除美国人士意味着敞口主要落在离岸及非美国参与者身上，产品监管基础仍是整个代币化股票赛道的一个变量。
updates.market_impact_en: The move channels spot demand for US equity and index exposure into Hyperliquid's USDC-settled order books, tying the venue's spot liquidity and HYPE-denominated activity to tokenized-equity flows that can run around the clock. The BVI debt-note structure and exclusion of US persons mean the exposure sits with offshore and non-US participants, leaving the product's regulatory footing a variable for the broader tokenized-equity segment.
